I'd like to stay within a sensible budget, what are my best options?
To keep things budget-friendly with us, you’ve got a few solid routes:
Get a custom quote: Your price depends on your dog’s details (number of dogs, ages, weights, activity, zip code, recipes), so we can tailor a plan that fits your budget.
Start small with retail: Try our Variety Pack or single packs through Chewy, Amazon, or PetSmart instead of jumping straight into a full subscription.
Use the trial wisely: Our two-week trial lets you test a full plan before recurring shipments kick in, and you can change or cancel anytime before your order deadline.
Adjust the meal plan: In your account you can:
Switch recipes
Choose full or half portions (great if you want to mix with another food to save money)
Change how many meal packs you get per day
Add extras strategically: Treats and probiotics can be added as one-time items instead of every box to control costs.
Those combos—mixing half portions, starting with retail packs, and tweaking your plan in the account—usually give the most budget control while still getting your pup Nom Nom meals.
